name: ERPNext
short_desc: Open-source ERP for accounting, inventory, CRM, HR and more
author: Frappe Technologies
description: ERPNext 16.33.0 with the IEF Bookkeeping Frappe app and local German/English OCR runtime. This package includes MariaDB and Redis and creates the first ERPNext site automatically.

form_fields.label: Administrator password
form_fields.hint: Password for the built-in Administrator account. It is used only when the site is first created; change it later from ERPNext.

form_fields.label: Database root password
form_fields.hint: Auto-generated MariaDB root password. Do not change it after first start; keep it with your app-data backup.
